regions.text: Early in February two colored families moved into a flat on Champlain Avenue, Chicago, where one white family already lived. The white tenant did not object, but the neighbors did. They warned the white tenant to absent herself on a certain night. Then they drove the colored people away and incidentally wrecked the white woman's furniture.

By means of deliberate thefts and thefts in the name of reform, for more than a quarter of a century, France and England have been acquiring section after section of Liberian territory.

Beginning in 1821 as an American colony with less than one hundred immigrants, Liberia in these ninety years has developed into a republic with a population of from 60,000 to 75,000 civilized Liberians engaged in the important work of perpetuating amid the more than 2,000,000 aboriginals the political, social and religious institutions of the American people.
